dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、ホームルーム、始めようか」
dialogues.en: "Alright, homeroom begins now."
dialogues.text: "Alright, homeroom begins now."

dialogues.jp: いつもと同じ一日の始まり。
dialogues.en: The usual starting of the school day.
dialogues.text: The usual starting of the school day.

dialogues.jp:
普通の学校の、普通の教室の、普通のＨＲ。た
だ一つ違っていたのは……。
dialogues.en:
Normal school, normal classroom, normal homeroom. That is,
except for one thing...
dialogues.text:
Normal school, normal classroom, normal homeroom. That is,
except for one thing...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「みんなに新しいクラスメートを紹介する」
dialogues.en: "Class, we'd be having a new student from today onwards."
dialogues.text: "Class, we'd be having a new student from today onwards."

dialogues.jp: 転校生？　また、変わった時期に。
dialogues.en: An exchange student? It's an odd time to take one in...
dialogues.text: An exchange student? It's an odd time to take one in...

dialogues.jp:
静かだった教室が一斉にざわめく。好奇心と期
待の視線が、教壇に集中した。
dialogues.en:
The formerly quiet classroom burst into murmurs. All eyes,
filled with curiosity, concentrated on the front of the
class.
dialogues.text:
The formerly quiet classroom burst into murmurs. All eyes,
filled with curiosity, concentrated on the front of the
class.

dialogues.jp: 教卓の前に『新しいクラスメート』が立つ。
dialogues.en: The "new classmate" stood by the teacher's desk.
dialogues.text: The "new classmate" stood by the teacher's desk.

dialogues.jp:
どこか古風な……おとなしい感じのする女の子
だった。なかなかの美少女だ。
dialogues.en:
The girl standing there seemed to be quite old-fashioned and
quiet. A pretty girl, as well.
dialogues.text:
The girl standing there seemed to be quite old-fashioned and
quiet. A pretty girl, as well.

dialogues.jp:
これで、女子の割合が増えるな。なんにせよ、
ムサい男じゃなくてよかった。
dialogues.en:
This will increase the girls ratio of this class. With the
amount of useless guys here, that has to be a good thing.
dialogues.text:
This will increase the girls ratio of this class. With the
amount of useless guys here, that has to be a good thing.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「本校に進学する直前という異例の時期だが」
dialogues.en:
"She was supposed to go to the main school, but there were
some complications at the time."
dialogues.text:
"She was supposed to go to the main school, but there were
some complications at the time."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「家庭である神社の都合で、今日から付属に通
　うことになった」
dialogues.en:
"For the convenience of her Shinto Shrine family, she has
been attached to this class."
dialogues.text:
"For the convenience of her Shinto Shrine family, she has
been attached to this class."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「みんな、仲良くするように」
dialogues.en: "Class, please welcome her."
dialogues.text: "Class, please welcome her."

dialogues.jp:
神社の娘という女の子は、うやうやしく頭を下
げ、自分の名前を名乗った。
dialogues.en: "My name is Konomiya Tamaki. I am pleased to meet everyone."
dialogues.text: "My name is Konomiya Tamaki. I am pleased to meet everyone."

dialogues.jp: ｛このみやたまき／胡ノ宮環｝といういかにも和風といった名前だ。
dialogues.en:
With a respectful bow, the Shinto daughter introduced
herself.
dialogues.text:
With a respectful bow, the Shinto daughter introduced
herself.

dialogues.jp:
制服を着ていても、どことなく『和』の雰囲気
が漂う。
dialogues.en:
Straightening her uniform, she emits a kind of peaceful aura
around her.
dialogues.text:
Straightening her uniform, she emits a kind of peaceful aura
around her.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、思わず頬杖をつきながらも、『胡ノ宮環』
を観察する。
dialogues.en:
With my fingers on my chin, I observe the still-standing
Konomiya Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
With my fingers on my chin, I observe the still-standing
Konomiya Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、かわいい、よな……。何となく品があり、
育ちの良さを思わせる。
dialogues.en: Mm, cute... And seems to have a refined upbringing as well.
dialogues.text: Mm, cute... And seems to have a refined upbringing as well.

dialogues.jp:
自己紹介が終わると、転校生はあたりをキョロ
キョロと見回し始めた。
dialogues.en:
After introducing herself, the exchange student started
looking left and right of the classroom, as if looking for
someone.
dialogues.text:
After introducing herself, the exchange student started
looking left and right of the classroom, as if looking for
someone.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　胡ノ宮どうした？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Is something wrong, Konomiya?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Is something wrong, Konomiya?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あの……。朝倉様は……？」
dialogues.en: "Uhm... Which person is Asakura-sama...?"
dialogues.text: "Uhm... Which person is Asakura-sama...?"

dialogues.jp:
暦先生が俺を見る。それにあわせて、転校生も
俺を見た。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi looked in my direction. Following her, Tamaki was
soon looking at me as well.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi looked in my direction. Following her, Tamaki was
soon looking at me as well.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "M, me?"
dialogues.text: "M, me?"

dialogues.jp: 転校生の胡ノ宮はじっと俺を見つめる。
dialogues.en: The exchange student Konomiya stared fervently at me.
dialogues.text: The exchange student Konomiya stared fervently at me.

dialogues.jp:
俺としては、彼女に見覚えがない。どうして、
俺の名前を知っているんだろうか。
dialogues.en:
I don't think I've seen this girl before. Why would she know
my name?
dialogues.text:
I don't think I've seen this girl before. Why would she know
my name?

dialogues.jp:
まさか、生き別れの妹とか言うんじゃないだろ
うな。
dialogues.en:
Don't tell me it's a long-lost sister, seperated at birth,
finally re-united again.
dialogues.text:
Don't tell me it's a long-lost sister, seperated at birth,
finally re-united again.

dialogues.jp: それとも、俺を狙うヒットマン？
dialogues.en: Or maybe, a hitman targeting me?
dialogues.text: Or maybe, a hitman targeting me?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.jp:
胡ノ宮は、俺から目を離さない。クラス中の視
線が自然と俺に集中する。
dialogues.en:
Konomiya's eyes' death grip on me would not waver. Along
with that, the rest of the class was soon staring at me as
well.
dialogues.text:
Konomiya's eyes' death grip on me would not waver. Along
with that, the rest of the class was soon staring at me as
well.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉とは知り合いだったのか？」
dialogues.en: "You know Asakura from somewhere?"
dialogues.text: "You know Asakura from somewhere?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。あの……私、朝倉様の｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝なんです」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Uhm... I am Asakura-sama's fiancee."
dialogues.text: "Yes. Uhm... I am Asakura-sama's fiancee."

dialogues.jp: 教室を衝撃が駆け抜けた。
dialogues.en: The shock ran right through the classroom.
dialogues.text: The shock ran right through the classroom.

dialogues.jp: 一斉にクラス中がどよめく。
dialogues.en:
The entire class was soon stirring with murmured
exclamations.
dialogues.text:
The entire class was soon stirring with murmured
exclamations.

dialogues.jp: え？　今、何て言った？
dialogues.en: Eh? What did she just say?
dialogues.text: Eh? What did she just say?

dialogues.en: Fi, fiancee????
dialogues.text: Fi, fiancee????

dialogues.jp:
許嫁って、『結婚の約束をしている人』ってい
うような意味の、アレ？
dialogues.en: Fiancee as in, the person you promise to marry?
dialogues.text: Fiancee as in, the person you promise to marry?

dialogues.jp: っていうか、あんた、誰？？？
dialogues.en: Argh, who the heck is she???
dialogues.text: Argh, who the heck is she???

dialogues.jp: 頭の中のハードディスクをフル回転させる。
dialogues.en: I made a full search of the hard disk in my brain.
dialogues.text: I made a full search of the hard disk in my brain.

dialogues.jp: 俺の人生で、そんな奇特なことがあったのか？
dialogues.en: I had done such a wonderful thing in my life?
dialogues.text: I had done such a wonderful thing in my life?

dialogues.jp: これまでの記憶を……検索、検索、検索。
dialogues.en: That memory... searching, searching, searching.
dialogues.text: That memory... searching, searching, searching.

dialogues.jp: 検索結果……該当ナシ。
dialogues.en: Search results.... 0 found.
dialogues.text: Search results.... 0 found.

dialogues.jp: いかん、全く思いだせん……。
dialogues.en: Damnit, I really don't remember...
dialogues.text: Damnit, I really don't remember...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、朝倉の許嫁だったのか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, so that's how you know him."
dialogues.text: "Oh, so that's how you know him."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ちょ、ちょ、ちょっと先生！　なんすか、そ
　のコメントは！　俺、その子のことなんて全
　然知らないッスよ」
dialogues.en:
"W, Wait a minute teacher! What's with that comment! I've
never met this girl before!"
dialogues.text:
"W, Wait a minute teacher! What's with that comment! I've
never met this girl before!"

dialogues.jp:
暦先生……あんた、簡単に受け入れすぎ。普通、
もっと驚くだろーが！
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei... she took that so easily. Why wasn't she
baffled at all!
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei... she took that so easily. Why wasn't she
baffled at all!

dialogues.jp:
もっとこう、『そんなバカな』とか『まだそん
なのは早い』とか……ねぇ？
dialogues.en:
It should be more like "That's crazy!" or "Isn't that a bit
too fast?"....right?
dialogues.text:
It should be more like "That's crazy!" or "Isn't that a bit
too fast?"....right?

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そうか、じゃあ、わからないことがあったら
　朝倉に教えてもらうといい」
dialogues.en:
"Is that so. Then, whatever Asakura doesn't know, please
explain to him."
dialogues.text:
"Is that so. Then, whatever Asakura doesn't know, please
explain to him."

dialogues.jp: ──無視ですか。
dialogues.en: --She's ignoring me.
dialogues.text: --She's ignoring me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい、わかりました」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I will do so."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I will do so."

dialogues.jp: 胡ノ宮も、なにまんま返事してるんだよ……。
dialogues.en: Tamaki also, replying in the same fashion...
dialogues.text: Tamaki also, replying in the same fashion...

dialogues.jp: いったい、許嫁ってどういうことだよ……。
dialogues.en: As if she's really my fiancee...
dialogues.text: As if she's really my fiancee...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前も隅に置けないな、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "I've underestimated you, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "I've underestimated you, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……いや、だから、俺はその子のことも、許
　嫁の話も何も知らないんだってば」
dialogues.en:
"...No, really, I don't know what this girl is talking
about!"
dialogues.text:
"...No, really, I don't know what this girl is talking
about!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は助けを求める意味も含めて、さりげなく音
夢の方を見る。
dialogues.en:
Desperately looking for someone to back me up, I glance in
Nemu's direction.
dialogues.text:
Desperately looking for someone to back me up, I glance in
Nemu's direction.

dialogues.jp: 俺と目が合うと、音夢はニッコリ微笑んだ。
dialogues.en: Meeting my eyes with hers, Nemu smiled sweetly at me.
dialogues.text: Meeting my eyes with hers, Nemu smiled sweetly at me.

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと待て……。お前まで何か誤解してない
か？　その微笑が、たまらなく怖いぞ……。
dialogues.en:
Come on... you don't realize this is all a misunderstanding?
That smile is scary...
dialogues.text:
Come on... you don't realize this is all a misunderstanding?
That smile is scary...

dialogues.jp:
教室では、突然の許嫁宣言に誰もが驚き、ヒソ
ヒソと会話を交わしている。
dialogues.en:
The class, still reeling from the shock of the fiancee
announcement, were whispering back and forth.
dialogues.text:
The class, still reeling from the shock of the fiancee
announcement, were whispering back and forth.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい。そこまでそこまで。詳しいことは
　休み時間にお互い、確かめるんだな」
dialogues.en:
"Alright, everyone settle down. We can confirm the details
during the break."
dialogues.text:
"Alright, everyone settle down. We can confirm the details
during the break."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、授業を始める。胡ノ宮、席について」
dialogues.en:
"I'll begin today's class. Konomiya, please go to your
seat."
dialogues.text:
"I'll begin today's class. Konomiya, please go to your
seat."

dialogues.jp:
なめるように見つめる、クラスメートたちの視
線の中を転校生は歩いていき……。
dialogues.en:
As if reprimanded, she walked to her seat with her head
down.
dialogues.text:
As if reprimanded, she walked to her seat with her head
down.

dialogues.jp: 俺のすぐ横で立ち止まった。
dialogues.en: And as she reached my desk, her footsteps stopped.
dialogues.text: And as she reached my desk, her footsteps stopped.

dialogues.jp: 俺のことをじっと見つめている。
dialogues.en: She stared at me again.
dialogues.text: She stared at me again.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、俺と君が許嫁ってその……」
dialogues.en: "Uh, about you being my fiancee and all..."
dialogues.text: "Uh, about you being my fiancee and all..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「これから、よろしくお願いします」
dialogues.en: "From here on... let us get along well."
dialogues.text: "From here on... let us get along well."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「えーと……その」
dialogues.en: "Uhm... about that...."
dialogues.text: "Uhm... about that...."

dialogues.jp: にっこりと笑う胡ノ宮。
dialogues.en: Konomiya was smiling radiantly.
dialogues.text: Konomiya was smiling radiantly.

dialogues.jp: 「その……、よろしく」
dialogues.en: "About that..... yes, let's."
dialogues.text: "About that..... yes, let's."

dialogues.jp:
結局、俺は胡ノ宮の笑顔に｛ほんろう／翻弄｝されながら、挨
拶を返してしまった。
dialogues.en: In the end, cowed by Konomiya's smile, I returned her words.
dialogues.text: In the end, cowed by Konomiya's smile, I returned her words.

dialogues.jp:
胡ノ宮はもう一度にっこりと微笑みながら、ペ
コリと頭を下げ、そのまま教室の一番後ろの席
へと歩いていった。
dialogues.en:
Konomiya smiled once more, then respectfully bowed again and
left for her seat at the rear of the classroom.
dialogues.text:
Konomiya smiled once more, then respectfully bowed again and
left for her seat at the rear of the classroom.

dialogues.jp: 待ちに待った休み時間。
dialogues.en: I can't wait for the break period.
dialogues.text: I can't wait for the break period.

dialogues.jp: 今日はいつもより授業が長かった気がする……。
dialogues.en: Today's lesson seems even longer than usual...
dialogues.text: Today's lesson seems even longer than usual...

dialogues.jp: それもこれも、あの許嫁宣言のせいだよな。
dialogues.en: Of course, it's all the fault of that fiancee declaration.
dialogues.text: Of course, it's all the fault of that fiancee declaration.

dialogues.jp: 正直、気になって授業どころじゃなかった。
dialogues.en: Frankly, the current lesson is nothing compared to that.
dialogues.text: Frankly, the current lesson is nothing compared to that.

dialogues.jp:
どうして会ったこともない転校生が、俺のこと
を知ってるんだ？
dialogues.en:
Why does this exchange student, whom I've never met before,
know who I am?
dialogues.text:
Why does this exchange student, whom I've never met before,
know who I am?

dialogues.jp: 前世に会ったことがある、とか……。
dialogues.en: Maybe we met in a previous life...
dialogues.text: Maybe we met in a previous life...

dialogues.jp: ……そんなメルヘンな設定は俺には合わん。
dialogues.en: ...I quickly shed such fairlytale thoughts out of my head.
dialogues.text: ...I quickly shed such fairlytale thoughts out of my head.

dialogues.jp: 実は俺が記憶喪失だとか……。
dialogues.en: The truth must be that I have amnesia...
dialogues.text: The truth must be that I have amnesia...

dialogues.jp: ……んな訳ないっての。
dialogues.en: ...yet I still remember everything else.
dialogues.text: ...yet I still remember everything else.

dialogues.jp: ううん。……ダメだ、思いだせん。
dialogues.en: Urgh... I really can't remember.
dialogues.text: Urgh... I really can't remember.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Nii-san."
dialogues.text: "Nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「やあ、音夢じゃないか！　元気かい？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, if it isn't Nemu! How are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, if it isn't Nemu! How are you doing?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、必要以上にニカニカ笑いながら、元気よ
く手を挙げる。
dialogues.en:
With a huge (and forced) smile, I energetically waved my
hand.
dialogues.text:
With a huge (and forced) smile, I energetically waved my
hand.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうやって、明るい声で誤魔化してもダメで
　す！」
dialogues.en: "Don't try to hide things with fake cheerfulness!"
dialogues.text: "Don't try to hide things with fake cheerfulness!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり……？」
dialogues.en: "Just as I thought...?"
dialogues.text: "Just as I thought...?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私が言いたいこともちろん分かりますよね？」
dialogues.en: "You know what I'm talking about, don't you?"
dialogues.text: "You know what I'm talking about, don't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……今日のお夕飯のメニューの話かなぁ」
dialogues.en: "...The menu for this evening's dinner, right?"
dialogues.text: "...The menu for this evening's dinner, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ここでお話もなんですから、食堂にでも行き
　ませんか？」
dialogues.en:
"Instead of talking here, shall we go to the cafeteria
instead?"
dialogues.text:
"Instead of talking here, shall we go to the cafeteria
instead?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……まったく、音夢さんたら、恥ずかしがり
　屋サンなんだから」
dialogues.en:
"...Oh, so you want to talk about something so embarassing
no one else can hear!"
dialogues.text:
"...Oh, so you want to talk about something so embarassing
no one else can hear!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうやって、ふざけてられるのも、今のうち
　ですからね」
dialogues.en:
"If you don't stop fooling around, we're going back home
instead."
dialogues.text:
"If you don't stop fooling around, we're going back home
instead."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "...Alright."
dialogues.text: "...Alright."

dialogues.jp: やはり、通じなかったか……。
dialogues.en: Looks like I can't escape...
dialogues.text: Looks like I can't escape...

dialogues.jp:
これから、叱られることを覚悟している子供み
たいな心境になる。
dialogues.en:
My mental state now is that of a kid trying to run away from
a scolding.
dialogues.text:
My mental state now is that of a kid trying to run away from
a scolding.

dialogues.jp: うう……このまま、どこか遠くに行きたい。
dialogues.en: Urgh... I want to be somewhere far away right now.
dialogues.text: Urgh... I want to be somewhere far away right now.

dialogues.jp:
そんなささやかな願いがかなえられるはずもな
く、俺は音夢に食堂へ連れられていった。
dialogues.en:
Knowing my modest wish was not goint to be granted, I
accompany Nemu to the cafeteria.
dialogues.text:
Knowing my modest wish was not goint to be granted, I
accompany Nemu to the cafeteria.

dialogues.jp: かくして……被告人席の俺。
dialogues.en: Time to prepare myself... the accused.
dialogues.text: Time to prepare myself... the accused.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん。どういうことですか？」
dialogues.en: "Nii-san, shall we continue where we left off?"
dialogues.text: "Nii-san, shall we continue where we left off?"

dialogues.jp: 前には、裏モードの音夢。
dialogues.en: In front of me, was reverse-mode Nemu.
dialogues.text: In front of me, was reverse-mode Nemu.

dialogues.jp: その顔は、笑いながらも引きつっている。
dialogues.en: Her face was smiling, hiding her obvious mood.
dialogues.text: Her face was smiling, hiding her obvious mood.

dialogues.jp: 俺の前にはうどん。
dialogues.en: In front of me was a bowl of udon.
dialogues.text: In front of me was a bowl of udon.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の前には親子丼。
dialogues.en: Nemu had a bowl of oyakudon.
dialogues.text: Nemu had a bowl of oyakudon.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、親子丼が減る気配なし。音夢の口はひ
たすら俺の追及に使われている。
dialogues.en:
However, her food had not even been touched. Nemu's mouth
was being used right now for interrogation purposes.
dialogues.text:
However, her food had not even been touched. Nemu's mouth
was being used right now for interrogation purposes.

dialogues.jp: 「どうって、何がだよ」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about!"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about!"

dialogues.jp: 「早く食わないと冷めるぞ」
dialogues.en: "Hurry up and eat before your food gets cold."
dialogues.text: "Hurry up and eat before your food gets cold."

dialogues.jp:
俺は心臓がなりっぱなしの心境を余所に、普段
通りを気取りながら、うどんをすする。
dialogues.en:
Trying to keep my heartbeat and mental state normal, I slurp
down my noodles.
dialogues.text:
Trying to keep my heartbeat and mental state normal, I slurp
down my noodles.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もう！　誤魔化さないで下さい！　もちろん
　許嫁の話です」
dialogues.en:
"Geez! Stop playing your deception games already! Of course
I'm talking about the whole fiancee business!"
dialogues.text:
"Geez! Stop playing your deception games already! Of course
I'm talking about the whole fiancee business!"

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、音夢は俺の箸を取り上げた。なん
てことしやがる？
dialogues.en: With those words, she took my chopsticks away.
dialogues.text: With those words, she took my chopsticks away.

dialogues.jp:
「な、なにするんだよ！　俺は許嫁のことなん
　か知らん。なんにも知らないんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"D, don't act like that! I really didn't know about the
fiancee thing. Absolutely nothing about it!"
dialogues.text:
"D, don't act like that! I really didn't know about the
fiancee thing. Absolutely nothing about it!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ウソばっかり！」
dialogues.en: "Liar!"
dialogues.text: "Liar!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ウソなんかつくかよ。だいたい胡ノ宮に会っ
　たのだって、今日が初めてなんだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not lying! Today was really the first day I ever met
Konomiya."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not lying! Today was really the first day I ever met
Konomiya."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあどうして、こういう事になるんですか？
　きっちり説明してくださいよ」
dialogues.en:
"Then why did this entire thing come about in the first
place? Please explain precisely!"
dialogues.text:
"Then why did this entire thing come about in the first
place? Please explain precisely!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「俺が聞きたいくらいだ！」
dialogues.en: "Did you listen to what I said at all?"
dialogues.text: "Did you listen to what I said at all?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は音夢から箸を取り返し、強制的に中断され
ていた昼食を再開する。
dialogues.en:
Grabbing back my chopsticks from her, I quickly resumed my
lunch.
dialogues.text:
Grabbing back my chopsticks from her, I quickly resumed my
lunch.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もう！　ずっと兄さんと一緒にいるけど、こ
　んな話、本当に初めて聞きましたよ！」
dialogues.en:
"Geez! I've been with you for so long, and this is really
the first time I've heard of this!"
dialogues.text:
"Geez! I've been with you for so long, and this is really
the first time I've heard of this!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だろうな、俺も初めてだ」
dialogues.en: "Of course, it's mine too."
dialogues.text: "Of course, it's mine too."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あのねぇ、兄さん……」
dialogues.en: "Then, brother..."
dialogues.text: "Then, brother..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だから、さっきから……って、おい、音夢」
dialogues.en: "That's why, just now.... oy, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "That's why, just now.... oy, Nemu."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「噂をすれば影……だ」
dialogues.en: "The main subject of the gossip....is here."
dialogues.text: "The main subject of the gossip....is here."

dialogues.jp: あごをしゃくって、食堂の入り口を示す。
dialogues.en: I motioned with my head to the entrance of the cafeteria.
dialogues.text: I motioned with my head to the entrance of the cafeteria.

dialogues.jp: 音夢はゆっくりと俺の示す方を向いた。
dialogues.en: Nemu slowly turned towards the direction I indicated.
dialogues.text: Nemu slowly turned towards the direction I indicated.

dialogues.jp:
ちょうど入り口から、胡ノ宮が食堂に入ってく
るところだった。
dialogues.en:
Standing at the entrance, Konomiya slowly entered the
cafeteria.
dialogues.text:
Standing at the entrance, Konomiya slowly entered the
cafeteria.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「誰か探してるのかな？」
dialogues.en: "Who's she looking for?"
dialogues.text: "Who's she looking for?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「わからん」
dialogues.en: "who knows."
dialogues.text: "who knows."

dialogues.jp: 胡ノ宮はキョロキョロとあたりを見回している。
dialogues.en: Konomiya restlessly looked around the entire cafeteria.
dialogues.text: Konomiya restlessly looked around the entire cafeteria.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、動きが止まった」
dialogues.en: "Ah, she stopped walking."
dialogues.text: "Ah, she stopped walking."

dialogues.jp: と、その瞬間、
dialogues.en: In that very moment
dialogues.text: In that very moment

dialogues.jp:
胡ノ宮は突然、自分の制服に手をかけ、勢いよ
く脱ぎ捨てた。
dialogues.en:
Konomiya had her hand on her uniform, and abruptly threw
them off her.
dialogues.text:
Konomiya had her hand on her uniform, and abruptly threw
them off her.

dialogues.jp:
ふわり、と、制服が宙を舞い、その下から、純
白の白衣と真紅の袴姿が現れる。
dialogues.en:
Time stopped as the uniform hung in midair. Below the flung
uniform, a pure white robe and hakama materialized from
nowhere.
dialogues.text:
Time stopped as the uniform hung in midair. Below the flung
uniform, a pure white robe and hakama materialized from
nowhere.

dialogues.jp: 「ぶーーーーーー！！」
dialogues.en: "Phuuuuuuuuuutt!!"
dialogues.text: "Phuuuuuuuuuutt!!"

dialogues.jp: 思わず、食べていたうどんを吹いてしまった。
dialogues.en: I spontaneously spat out the udon I was eating.
dialogues.text: I spontaneously spat out the udon I was eating.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「に、兄さん……あれ？」
dialogues.en: "N, nii-san...huh?"
dialogues.text: "N, nii-san...huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あれは正に、神社の……」
dialogues.en: "That, that has to be, a Shinto shrine..."
dialogues.text: "That, that has to be, a Shinto shrine..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「巫女さん？」
dialogues.en: "Maiden?"
dialogues.text: "Maiden?"

dialogues.jp: その通りだった。
dialogues.en: Indeed.
dialogues.text: Indeed.

dialogues.jp:
背筋をピンと伸ばした胡ノ宮が、どういう理由
かはわからないが……。
dialogues.en:
As Konomiya straightened her spine, I tried to figure how
what she's trying to do, and failed horribly...
dialogues.text:
As Konomiya straightened her spine, I tried to figure how
what she's trying to do, and failed horribly...

dialogues.jp: 巫女装束で、この風見学園の食堂に立っている。
dialogues.en:
All I knew was, a shrine maiden is in Kazami Academy's
cafeteria right now.
dialogues.text:
All I knew was, a shrine maiden is in Kazami Academy's
cafeteria right now.

dialogues.jp: 「そういえば家が神社だとか言ってたな……」
dialogues.en: "It was said that her family are Shinto..."
dialogues.text: "It was said that her family are Shinto..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、このシチュエーションには全く関係な
　いでしょ！」
dialogues.en: "But that has nothing to do with this situation!"
dialogues.text: "But that has nothing to do with this situation!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「音夢、制服の下に、あんなかさばる物が着れ
　るもんなのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Nemu, how on earth did she managed to fit that bulky
costume under her uniform?"
dialogues.text:
"Nemu, how on earth did she managed to fit that bulky
costume under her uniform?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私に聞かないで、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "I'm not listening, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "I'm not listening, nii-san."

dialogues.jp:
ささやかな兄妹の会話を、更に実りあるものに
するべく……。
dialogues.en:
The idle sibling conversation certainly did not match what
was happening right now...
dialogues.text:
The idle sibling conversation certainly did not match what
was happening right now...

dialogues.jp:
胡ノ宮はどこから取り出したのか、弓矢を手に
持っていた。
dialogues.en:
Konomiya, again producing something from nothing, suddenly
had a bow and arrow in her hands.
dialogues.text:
Konomiya, again producing something from nothing, suddenly
had a bow and arrow in her hands.

dialogues.jp:
「なっ、ゆ、弓だとぉ！？　狩りでもする気か？
　いや、そんなことより、どこからあんなもの
　をッ！」
dialogues.en: "Wha, a, a bow?! Does she think she'a an archer?!"
dialogues.text: "Wha, a, a bow?! Does she think she'a an archer?!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だから！　私に聞かないでよ」
dialogues.en: "I told you! I'm not listening!"
dialogues.text: "I told you! I'm not listening!"

dialogues.jp: 胡ノ宮はゆっくりと弓を引き、手を、離す。
dialogues.en:
Konomiya slowly pulled back on the bow's string, and then
her hand released it.
dialogues.text:
Konomiya slowly pulled back on the bow's string, and then
her hand released it.

dialogues.jp: 視線は、矢が走る方向へと注がれる。
dialogues.en: My eyes instinctively followed the route of the arrow.
dialogues.text: My eyes instinctively followed the route of the arrow.

dialogues.jp: ──ビュンッ。
dialogues.en: --*byun*
dialogues.text: --*byun*

dialogues.jp: ──バキ！
dialogues.en: --*haki*
dialogues.text: --*haki*

dialogues.jp:
矢は、俺たちの近くにいた男子生徒の丼を貫通
し、モノの見事に真っ二つに断ち割った。
dialogues.en:
The arrow had pierced the bowl of a poor male student near
us, splitting it into two equal pieces.
dialogues.text:
The arrow had pierced the bowl of a poor male student near
us, splitting it into two equal pieces.

dialogues.jp: テ、テレビのロケか？
dialogues.en: A, a television shoot location?
dialogues.text: A, a television shoot location?

dialogues.jp: しかし、どこにもカメラはない。
dialogues.en: But there aren't any cameras around...
dialogues.text: But there aren't any cameras around...

dialogues.jp: どっきり……でもないらしい。
dialogues.en: Or so it seemed anyway.
dialogues.text: Or so it seemed anyway.

dialogues.jp: 食堂中の視線が胡ノ宮に集まる。
dialogues.en: All eyes in the cafeteria immediately centered on Konomiya.
dialogues.text: All eyes in the cafeteria immediately centered on Konomiya.

dialogues.jp:
胡ノ宮はまるで娯楽時代劇か、格闘ゲームに出
てくるヒロインのように、巫女装束に弓矢といっ
た出で立ちで立ち尽くしている。
dialogues.en:
Konomiya remained still, holding her bow and arrow and in
her shrine maiden costume like some sort of fighting game
character.
dialogues.text:
Konomiya remained still, holding her bow and arrow and in
her shrine maiden costume like some sort of fighting game
character.

dialogues.jp:
気の毒な男子学生は、真っ二つになった丼を、
放心状態で眺めていた。
dialogues.en:
The poor male student, with his bowl split in half,
absentmindedly gazed at her.
dialogues.text:
The poor male student, with his bowl split in half,
absentmindedly gazed at her.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「申し訳ありません。ちょっと、手元が狂って
　しまって……。お騒がせいたしました」
dialogues.en:
"My deepest apologies. I was overstepping my bounadries... I
am deeply sorry for scaring you."
dialogues.text:
"My deepest apologies. I was overstepping my bounadries... I
am deeply sorry for scaring you."

dialogues.jp:
胡ノ宮はその男子にそう言いながら、深々と頭
を下げた。
dialogues.en: With those words, Konomiya deeply bowed to the guy.
dialogues.text: With those words, Konomiya deeply bowed to the guy.

dialogues.jp: 「手元が狂った……ねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Overstepping her boundaries...eh."
dialogues.text: "Overstepping her boundaries...eh."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……というか、思いっきり故意に見えたのは
　私だけ？　兄さん」
dialogues.en: "...Do you think she was aiming for me, brother?"
dialogues.text: "...Do you think she was aiming for me, brother?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「安心しろ。同じ疑問を持った奴は、この食堂
　の客の数ほどはいると思う」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry, I bet everyone else in this classroom is
asking the same question."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry, I bet everyone else in this classroom is
asking the same question."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「で、今のは何？」
dialogues.en: "Then, what was that?"
dialogues.text: "Then, what was that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……知らん。俺に聞くな」
dialogues.en:
"...I don't know. First time I've ever seen, or heard of
something like this."
dialogues.text:
"...I don't know. First time I've ever seen, or heard of
something like this."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Oh my, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Oh my, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: 胡ノ宮が、俺たちに気づいて話しかけてくる。
dialogues.en: Konomiya approached us, and started talking to us.
dialogues.text: Konomiya approached us, and started talking to us.

dialogues.jp: 「……や、やあ、胡ノ宮……だよな」
dialogues.en: "...H, hi, Konomiya."
dialogues.text: "...H, hi, Konomiya."

dialogues.jp: ……ここは、普通に、普通に。
dialogues.en: ....Stay calm, stay calm.
dialogues.text: ....Stay calm, stay calm.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「こ、こんにちは、胡ノ宮さん」
dialogues.en: "Go, good afternoon, Konomiya."
dialogues.text: "Go, good afternoon, Konomiya."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ど、どうした、音夢？　こ、声が上ずってる
　ぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"Wh, what's wrong Nemu? You, your voice seems to have gotten
higher?"
dialogues.text:
"Wh, what's wrong Nemu? You, your voice seems to have gotten
higher?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「や、やだ、兄さんこそ」
dialogues.en: "N, no, more like yours."
dialogues.text: "N, no, more like yours."

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺たちの様子に気づいているのか、気づ
いていないのか、胡ノ宮は平然としている。
dialogues.en:
Whether she noticed our obvious nervousness, Konomiya
remained cool and calm.
dialogues.text:
Whether she noticed our obvious nervousness, Konomiya
remained cool and calm.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「先ほどは失礼いたしました」
dialogues.en: "I am very sorry for just now."
dialogues.text: "I am very sorry for just now."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Huh? Wh, what about?..."
dialogues.text: "Huh? Wh, what about?..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「教室で……。まさかあんな騒ぎになるとは思
　いませんでした」
dialogues.en:
"In class... I did not think that I would shock so many
people."
dialogues.text:
"In class... I did not think that I would shock so many
people."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「親が決めた許嫁ということでしたので」
dialogues.en: "My parents had decided that I was to be your fiancee."
dialogues.text: "My parents had decided that I was to be your fiancee."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「私といたしましても、気になりまして……」
dialogues.en: "So I thought that I should bring it up..."
dialogues.text: "So I thought that I should bring it up..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ああ、許嫁宣言のことか……」
dialogues.en: "A, ahh, the fiancee announcement..."
dialogues.text: "A, ahh, the fiancee announcement..."

dialogues.jp: 瞬間的に、今の騒ぎで完全に頭から抜けていた。
dialogues.en: In that moment, all my fears dropped out of my head.
dialogues.text: In that moment, all my fears dropped out of my head.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当にお騒がせしました」
dialogues.en: "I am really sorry for being such a bother."
dialogues.text: "I am really sorry for being such a bother."

dialogues.jp:
と、にっこり微笑む胡ノ宮は、今の状況を全く
気にした様子はない。
dialogues.en:
And as she smiled and apologized at the same time, her face
showed no signs of worry about the situation she just
described.
dialogues.text:
And as she smiled and apologized at the same time, her face
showed no signs of worry about the situation she just
described.

dialogues.jp: ならば、こちらも臆することはない。
dialogues.en: If that's the case, then I have nothing to fear either.
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then I have nothing to fear either.

dialogues.jp:
聞きたいことはいくらでもあるんだから、この
場でハッキリさせといた方がいい。
dialogues.en: At least, now I can find out exactly what's going on.
dialogues.text: At least, now I can find out exactly what's going on.

dialogues.jp:
「親が決めた許嫁って、どういうこと？　俺は
　胡ノ宮はもちろん、胡ノ宮の両親にだって会っ
　たことないんだぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"You say your parents decided that you were to be my
fiancee? I'm certain that I've never met your parents
though, have I?"
dialogues.text:
"You say your parents decided that you were to be my
fiancee? I'm certain that I've never met your parents
though, have I?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「は？　わからない？」
dialogues.en: "The truth is, I do not know much about it either..."
dialogues.text: "The truth is, I do not know much about it either..."

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、どうして、俺と胡ノ宮が許嫁になっ
　ているんだろう。本当に会ったことないんだ
　ぜ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? You don't know?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? You don't know?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「それが……。母は、私と朝倉様の間には深い
　絆があるって言うんです」
dialogues.en:
"I.... have no real recollection of my childhood. The place
of my birth, the people I had played with--"
dialogues.text:
"I.... have no real recollection of my childhood. The place
of my birth, the people I had played with--"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "All of those, I have completely forgotten."
dialogues.text: "All of those, I have completely forgotten."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わかりません」
dialogues.en:
"And, the oldest memory that I can recall, was that of my
mother promising me to an Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text:
"And, the oldest memory that I can recall, was that of my
mother promising me to an Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「つまりは、どんな絆かはわからないけれど、
　俺と胡ノ宮の間には、何か深い絆があるって
　ことか」
dialogues.en:
"About that... my mother had told me that this Asakura-sama
and myself shared a deep bond."
dialogues.text:
"About that... my mother had told me that this Asakura-sama
and myself shared a deep bond."

dialogues.jp:
いったい、どんな……。やはり前世ネタじゃな
いだろうな……。
dialogues.en: "Bond...?"
dialogues.text: "Bond...?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくしも母に何度も尋ねたのですが、それ
　が何かを教えてくれないんです」
dialogues.en: "I do not know."
dialogues.text: "I do not know."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ただ、朝倉様の側にいれば、いずれわかるか
　らって……」
dialogues.en:
"I had asked my mother several times about the true meaining
of her words, but she did not say much more."
dialogues.text:
"I had asked my mother several times about the true meaining
of her words, but she did not say much more."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そんなものかね……」
dialogues.en:
"Only that when I meet Asakura-sama, would be the time where
I understand everything..."
dialogues.text:
"Only that when I meet Asakura-sama, would be the time where
I understand everything..."

dialogues.jp:
許嫁である根拠がさっぱりわからない現状では、
胡ノ宮の母親が何を知っているのかしらないが
いまいち、ピンと来ない。
dialogues.en:
But us being bonded to be fiancees, despite not knowing each
other at all; I still don't understand...
dialogues.text:
But us being bonded to be fiancees, despite not knowing each
other at all; I still don't understand...

dialogues.jp:
もちろん俺の知らない｛・・・／深い絆｝があったからって、
俺が素直に『ハイ、俺は胡ノ宮の許嫁です』っ
て訳にはいかないと思うけど。
dialogues.en:
Of course, if I don't know anything about this "deep bond",
I can't just obediently say "Yes, I am Konomiya's fiance".
dialogues.text:
Of course, if I don't know anything about this "deep bond",
I can't just obediently say "Yes, I am Konomiya's fiance".

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ですから、この学園で朝倉様と一緒に過す中
　で答えを見つけたいと思っているんです」
dialogues.en:
"That is why I have come to this school, in order to find
out together with Asakura-sama, the real answer."
dialogues.text:
"That is why I have come to this school, in order to find
out together with Asakura-sama, the real answer."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Answer, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Answer, huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そうすればきっと、わたくしと朝倉様が許嫁
　であることの意味もわかると思います」
dialogues.en:
"I definitely want to understand the meaning behind our
engagement."
dialogues.text:
"I definitely want to understand the meaning behind our
engagement."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「許嫁の意味……か」
dialogues.en: "The meaning behind the engagement..."
dialogues.text: "The meaning behind the engagement..."

dialogues.jp:
本人同士に自覚のない許嫁に、意味なんてある
のかどうかわからない。
dialogues.en:
An arranged engagement whose true meaning the two involved
parties don't know about...
dialogues.text:
An arranged engagement whose true meaning the two involved
parties don't know about...

dialogues.jp: 大昔の日本じゃあるまいし。
dialogues.en: Not dissimilar to ancient Japan.
dialogues.text: Not dissimilar to ancient Japan.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、結局のところ、よくはわからないけれど、
　その深い絆ってのが本当にあるなら、ぜひ知
　りたいところだね」
dialogues.en:
"No matter what, if there really is some deep bond between
us, we'd definitely find out about it."
dialogues.text:
"No matter what, if there really is some deep bond between
us, we'd definitely find out about it."

dialogues.jp: 俺だって、興味がない訳じゃない。
dialogues.en: I'm definitely interested in this now.
dialogues.text: I'm definitely interested in this now.

dialogues.jp:
会ったこともない人との絆があるって言われて
も正直ピンとこないし、あまり気持ちのいいも
のではない。
dialogues.en:
There's somehow a nice feeling to it... two people who have
never met, yet share some sort of bond with each other.
dialogues.text:
There's somehow a nice feeling to it... two people who have
never met, yet share some sort of bond with each other.

dialogues.jp:
それに、もし、胡ノ宮と俺が許嫁となる運命で
あるのならば……。
dialogues.en:
And also, if it really is fate that Konomiya is to be my
fiancee...
dialogues.text:
And also, if it really is fate that Konomiya is to be my
fiancee...

dialogues.jp:
こんな綺麗な女の子とケッコンかぁ……。それ
もいいかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
Getting married to such a beautiful girl... that's not
something to be unhappy about either.
dialogues.text:
Getting married to such a beautiful girl... that's not
something to be unhappy about either.

dialogues.jp: 思わず、ニヤけてしまいそうだ。
dialogues.en: I unconciously smile to myself.
dialogues.text: I unconciously smile to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「へえ、深い絆ね……」
dialogues.en: "Heeh, a deep bond eh..."
dialogues.text: "Heeh, a deep bond eh..."

dialogues.jp:
音夢の目からは、俺に向かって照準レーザーが
発せられているように見える。
dialogues.en: Nemu's eyes were wandering off in thought as well.
dialogues.text: Nemu's eyes were wandering off in thought as well.

dialogues.jp:
一人だけ、あまり楽天的に考えられないお方が
いらっしゃるようですな……。
dialogues.en:
From anyone else's perspective, it's hard to be optimistic
that we'd actually find this answer we're searching for...
dialogues.text:
From anyone else's perspective, it's hard to be optimistic
that we'd actually find this answer we're searching for...

dialogues.jp: 気持ちはわからんでもないけれど。
dialogues.en:
But it would be more of a case of them not understanding
this feeling of having this sort of bond.
dialogues.text:
But it would be more of a case of them not understanding
this feeling of having this sort of bond.

dialogues.jp:
ふと、見ると、胡ノ宮がなにか言いにくそうに
俺の方を見ていた。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, Konomiya looked at me and started trying to say
something.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, Konomiya looked at me and started trying to say
something.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……あの、よかったら『環』って呼んでくだ
　さい。二人は、許嫁な訳ですし……」
dialogues.en:
"...Uhm, if you could, please address me as "Tamaki" from
now on. We are engaged after all..."
dialogues.text:
"...Uhm, if you could, please address me as "Tamaki" from
now on. We are engaged after all..."

dialogues.jp: 胡ノ宮は、俯き加減で恥ずかしそうに言う。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked down embarassingly as she said this.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked down embarassingly as she said this.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、許嫁ってのはともかく、別にいいよ。
　少なくとも、俺と胡ノ宮は、友達だからな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, engaged or not, I'm fine with it. After all, from now
on, you and I are friends."
dialogues.text:
"Well, engaged or not, I'm fine with it. After all, from now
on, you and I are friends."

dialogues.jp:
会って、その日に友達ってのもどうかと思うけ
れど、俺は胡ノ宮──環とは、仲良くなれそう
な気がしていた。
dialogues.en:
Even though we've just met, I somehow feel that
Konomiya--Tamaki and I could make great friends.
dialogues.text:
Even though we've just met, I somehow feel that
Konomiya--Tamaki and I could make great friends.

dialogues.jp:
それも、これも、おそらくは許嫁発言によるも
のだろうな。
dialogues.en: And perhaps even fufill that engagement proposal.
dialogues.text: And perhaps even fufill that engagement proposal.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった……」
dialogues.en: "Thank you..."
dialogues.text: "Thank you..."

dialogues.jp: 俺の言葉に、環はニッコリと微笑む。
dialogues.en: From my words, Tamaki smiled beautifully.
dialogues.text: From my words, Tamaki smiled beautifully.

dialogues.jp: その笑顔が、妙に嬉しそうだ。
dialogues.en: That smile, delicate and charming.
dialogues.text: That smile, delicate and charming.

dialogues.jp:
女の子って、どうも下の名前で呼ばれると嬉し
いみたいだな。
dialogues.en:
The fact that I can call such a girl by her first name makes
me happy as well.
dialogues.text:
The fact that I can call such a girl by her first name makes
me happy as well.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、俺の方も[name]でいいよ」
dialogues.en: "In that case, call me [name] as well."
dialogues.text: "In that case, call me [name] as well."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい……朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "I understand... Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "I understand... Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: ま、いいか。
dialogues.en: Well, whatever.
dialogues.text: Well, whatever.

dialogues.jp:
呼び方なんて、その人が呼びやすければいいわ
けだし。
dialogues.en:
As long as she actually calls for me, I don't really care
what she calls me.
dialogues.text:
As long as she actually calls for me, I don't really care
what she calls me.

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、音夢の視線が痛かったが、まあ、
そんな呼び方程度でヤキモチ焼かれてもな。
dialogues.en:
Nemu's eyes look hurt as well; no doubt she's feeling some
sort of jealousy.
dialogues.text:
Nemu's eyes look hurt as well; no doubt she's feeling some
sort of jealousy.

dialogues.jp:
音夢もそれがわかっているせいか、口を挟んで
はこなかった。
dialogues.en:
She knows that, but of course can't really say much, now
anyway.
dialogues.text:
She knows that, but of course can't really say much, now
anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「それではわたくし、お弁当を教室に置いてき
　てしまいましたので、失礼いたします」
dialogues.en:
"If that is settled, than I will retire to the classroom for
my lunch. Farewell."
dialogues.text:
"If that is settled, than I will retire to the classroom for
my lunch. Farewell."

dialogues.jp:
と、深々と頭を下げる胡ノ宮。行動は突飛でも、
礼儀は正しいらしい。
dialogues.en:
Another deep bow. Her movements are extremely controlled and
polite.
dialogues.text:
Another deep bow. Her movements are extremely controlled and
polite.

dialogues.jp:
胡ノ宮はそのまま、食堂の出口へと去っていっ
た。
dialogues.en: With that, Konomiya left the cafeteria.
dialogues.text: With that, Konomiya left the cafeteria.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "That was..."
dialogues.text: "That was..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「さあな。まあ、どっちにしても今のところ明
　確な根拠はよくわからないみたいだし、俺が
　宇宙人に記憶を消された訳でもないようだ」
dialogues.en:
"Pretty much. Although the basic reason is still unknown, at
least I know I haven't had my memories stolen by aliens or
something."
dialogues.text:
"Pretty much. Although the basic reason is still unknown, at
least I know I haven't had my memories stolen by aliens or
something."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、にゅるにゅるに伸びたうどんを口に運ぶ。
dialogues.en: I bring a helping of udon into my mouth,
dialogues.text: I bring a helping of udon into my mouth,

dialogues.jp: 箸でつまんだだけでぷつりと千切れるうどん。
dialogues.en: using my chopsticks to cut the extra parts.
dialogues.text: using my chopsticks to cut the extra parts.

dialogues.jp:
「人生は、このうどんのように、入り組んでい
　るのだ……」
dialogues.en: "Life is like a bowl of udon, extremely complicated..."
dialogues.text: "Life is like a bowl of udon, extremely complicated..."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は、バカにするような目で俺を見ていた。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked at me with eyes that said "what an idiot".
dialogues.text: Nemu looked at me with eyes that said "what an idiot".

dialogues.jp:
このうどんが人生ならば、俺の人生は、かなり
｛もろ／脆｝いものらしい。
dialogues.en:
The fragileness of the udon indeed closely mirrors that of
life.
dialogues.text:
The fragileness of the udon indeed closely mirrors that of
life.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、人生の｛・／汁｝をずずず、とすすった。
dialogues.en: I slowly drink up the soup of life.
dialogues.text: I slowly drink up the soup of life.

dialogues.jp: ◆転校生は許嫁◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Exchange Student is My Fiancee◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Exchange Student is My Fiancee◆

dialogues.jp:
卒業間近に引っ越してきた転校生は、俺の｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝
だと宣言した。
dialogues.en:
The exchange student, who moved to our class close to
graduation, declared that she was my fiancee.
dialogues.text:
The exchange student, who moved to our class close to
graduation, declared that she was my fiancee.

dialogues.jp:
昼休みの食堂で、男子生徒の食べていた丼に矢
を射り、転校早々から注目を浴びている。
環は、俺との間に深い絆があると言う。
絆って、なんなんだ……。
